content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Kanpur Assistant Project Manager Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 15-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Kanpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kanpur Assistant Project Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Assistant Project Manager post at IIT Kanpur is 15 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Project Manager position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post graduate degree or a Graduate degree along with at least 3 years of relevant experience to be eligible for the Assistant Project Manager role.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for the IIT Kanpur Assistant Project Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Assistant Project Manager recruitment at IIT Kanpur.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Project Manager post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Assistant Project Manager position will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 16,000 to Rs. 38,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Project Manager post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Assistant Project Manager position at the Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application for the Assistant Project Manager position at IIT Kanpur must be submitted through the online mode only.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Assistant Project Manager role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Project Manager recruitment involves shortlisting of candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Assistant Project Manager position at IIT Kanpur is a contractual job type.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Kanpur located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur is located in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply offline for this position?
faq.answer: No, applications for the Assistant Project Manager position at IIT Kanpur must be submitted online. Offline applications will not be accepted.
